Supply / Exhaust Air Valve

Product Description Disc Valve is an adjustable air terminal device used for supply and exhaust air applications
                            in ventilation systems. The airflow is controlled by rotating the central disc to adjust the
                            free area between disc and frame. Key Features Alternative to
                                ceiling diffuser Adjustable airflow control Simple aesthetic design Suitable for
                                damp environments Supply or exhaust use Tight air sealing design Low noise operation Corrosion resistant
